gizmo.title: Poll
gizmo.description: A question with no right answer, where the point is seeing how everyone answered.

configure.title: Question
configure.description: What everyone is asked. There is no right answer.

configure.title: Options
configure.description: The choices to vote on. Add at least two.

configure.title: Results show
configure.description: When a learner sees how everyone voted.

advanced.title: Closes
advanced.description: Date and time voting stops. Leave empty for a poll that stays open.

advanced.title: Allow changing a vote
advanced.description: Let a learner change their vote during the same visit.

advanced.title: Results address
advanced.description: Optional web address (http or https) that counts votes and answers with the totals. Leave empty when a plugin supplies results or none are shown.

properties.question: When a layout breaks, what do you do first?

demoSchema.content: <input value="Open DevTools"><input value="Rewrite the CSS"><input value="Ask a classmate"><input value="Search the error">
